title: Grade 6 ISLAMIC RELIGIOUS EDUCATION — General Assessment #2

pages.quiz:
ISLAMIC RELIGIOUS EDUCATION — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #2
====

GRADE: Grade 6
SUBJECT: ISLAMIC RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KPSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Which response best shows understanding of Saum? (1 mark)
   A. Use Saum to insult classmates of other faiths.
   B. Say Saum has no place in daily life.
   C. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Saum.
   D. Apply the teaching of Saum with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

2. Which response best shows understanding of Selected Surah? (1 mark)
   A. Use Selected Surah to insult classmates of other faiths.
   B. Apply the teaching of Selected Surah with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   C. Say Selected Surah has no place in daily life.
   D. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Selected Surah.

3. A good steward of creation should: (1 mark)
   A. Destroy trees without planting
   B. Care for the environment and use resources wisely
   C. Waste food daily
   D. Pollute rivers deliberately

4. Which response best shows understanding of Hadith on dressing? (1 mark)
   A. Use Hadith on dressing to insult classmates of other faiths.
   B. Apply the teaching of Hadith on dressing with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   C. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Hadith on dressing.
   D. Say Hadith on dressing has no place in daily life.

5. Which response best shows understanding of Taqwa? (1 mark)
   A. Apply the teaching of Taqwa with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   B. Say Taqwa has no place in daily life.
   C. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Taqwa.
   D. Use Taqwa to insult classmates of other faiths.

6. Which response best shows understanding of Hajj? (1 mark)
   A. Use Hajj to insult classmates of other faiths.
   B. Say Hajj has no place in daily life.
   C. Apply the teaching of Hajj with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   D. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Hajj.

7. Which response best shows understanding of Stories of Prophets:? (1 mark)
   A. Use Stories of Prophets: to insult classmates of other faiths.
   B. Apply the teaching of Stories of Prophets: with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   C. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Stories of Prophets:.
   D. Say Stories of Prophets: has no place in daily life.

8. Which response best shows understanding of Hadith on responsible use of human capabilities and resources? (1 mark)
   A. Use Hadith on responsible use of human capabilities and resources to insult classmates of other faiths.
   B. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Hadith on responsible use of human capabilities and resources.
   C. Say Hadith on responsible use of human capabilities and resources has no place in daily life.
   D. Apply the teaching of Hadith on responsible use of human capabilities and resources with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

9. Respect in religious education is shown by: (1 mark)
   A. Skipping all moral lessons
   B. Listening to others and living values taught at home and school
   C. Refusing to help a neighbour
   D. Mocking other people’s beliefs

10. Honesty means: (1 mark)
   A. Telling the truth and keeping trust
   B. Spreading rumours
   C. Cheating in exams
   D. Hiding stolen items

11. Which response best shows understanding of Hadith on Purity of Actions? (1 mark)
   A. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Hadith on Purity of Actions.
   B. Say Hadith on Purity of Actions has no place in daily life.
   C. Apply the teaching of Hadith on Purity of Actions with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   D. Use Hadith on Purity of Actions to insult classmates of other faiths.

12. Which response best shows understanding of Zakat:? (1 mark)
   A. Use Zakat: to insult classmates of other faiths.
   B. Say Zakat: has no place in daily life.
   C. Apply the teaching of Zakat: with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   D. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Zakat:.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
13. In three clear sentences, explain Zakat: and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

14. In three clear sentences, explain Saum and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

15. In three clear sentences, explain Hajj and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

16. In three clear sentences, explain Virtues: Ibadah and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
pages.answers:
MARKING SCHEME
====

1. D — Apply the teaching of Saum with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

2. B — Apply the teaching of Selected Surah with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

3. B — Care for the environment and use resources wisely

4. B — Apply the teaching of Hadith on dressing with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

5. A — Apply the teaching of Taqwa with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

6. C — Apply the teaching of Hajj with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

7. B — Apply the teaching of Stories of Prophets: with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

8. D — Apply the teaching of Hadith on responsible use of human capabilities and resources with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

9. B — Listening to others and living values taught at home and school

10. A — Telling the truth and keeping trust

11. C — Apply the teaching of Hadith on Purity of Actions with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

12. C — Apply the teaching of Zakat: with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

13. (4 marks)
Award marks for: (1) accurate definition/idea of Zakat:; (2) correct use of subject terms; (3) a relevant local example (home, school, market, farm, or community). Do not award for slogans with no content.

14. (4 marks)
Award marks for: (1) accurate definition/idea of Saum; (2) correct use of subject terms; (3) a relevant local example (home, school, market, farm, or community). Do not award for slogans with no content.

15. (4 marks)
Award marks for: (1) accurate definition/idea of Hajj; (2) correct use of subject terms; (3) a relevant local example (home, school, market, farm, or community). Do not award for slogans with no content.

16. (4 marks)
Award marks for: (1) accurate definition/idea of Virtues: Ibadah; (2) correct use of subject terms; (3) a relevant local example (home, school, market, farm, or community). Do not award for slogans with no content.
